ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_BusinessOnlineBankingAccount_bob
AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_BusinessOnlineBankingAccount
AS(
    SELECT
     BTA.ID AS Id
    ,BTA.VERSION AS Version
    ,BTA.NO AS RelatedCustomerAccountId
    ,BTA.TYPE_CD AS TypeCdId
    ,BTA.NAME AS Name
    ,BTA.IS_OWN AS OwnIndicator
    ,BTA.REF_NO AS ReferenceNumber
    ,BTA.INTERNAL_REMARKS AS InternalRemarks
    ,BTA.EXTERNAL_REMARKS AS ExternalRemarks
    ,BTA.CURRENCY_CD AS IsoCurrencyCode
    ,BTA.CORP_ID AS CustomerAccountId
    ,BTA.BRANCH_CD AS BranchId
    ,BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,'BOB' AS SourceCode
    ,BTAD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BTA.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.BOB_TBLACCOUNT_DELTA BTAD 
LEFT JOIN BUSC.BOB_TBLACCOUNT BTA ON BTAD.ID = BTA.ID AND BTAD.VERSION = BTA.VERSION AND BTA.ISLATEST = 1 

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_BusinessOnlineBankingAccount FROM TEMP_BNKM_BusinessOnlineBankingAccount;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_BusinessOnlineBankingAccount_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
 Id
,Version
,RelatedCustomerAccountId
,TypeCdId
,Name
,OwnIndicator
,ReferenceNumber
,InternalRemarks
,ExternalRemarks
,IsoCurrencyCode
,CustomerAccountId
,BranchId
)) HASHROW, Id,Version, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_BusinessOnlineBankingAccount WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_BusinessOnlineBankingAccount_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
 Id
,Version
,RelatedCustomerAccountId
,TypeCdId
,Name
,OwnIndicator
,ReferenceNumber
,InternalRemarks
,ExternalRemarks
,IsoCurrencyCode
,CustomerAccountId
,BranchId
)) HASHROW, Id, Version
FROM BNKM.BusinessOnlineBankingAccount --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'CRM'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_BusinessOnlineBankingAccount_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.Id,TGT.Id) AS Id
	,ISNULL(SRC.Version,TGT.Version) AS Version
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_BusinessOnlineBankingAccount_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_BusinessOnlineBankingAccount_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.Id = TGT.Id
AND SRC.Version = TGT.Version
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_BusinessOnlineBankingAccount_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_BusinessOnlineBankingAccount_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT 
SET
 Id = SRC.Id
,Version = SRC.Version
,RelatedCustomerAccountId = SRC.RelatedCustomerAccountId
,TypeCdId = SRC.TypeCdId
,Name = SRC.Name
,OwnIndicator = SRC.OwnIndicator
,ReferenceNumber = SRC.ReferenceNumber
,InternalRemarks = SRC.InternalRemarks
,ExternalRemarks = SRC.ExternalRemarks
,IsoCurrencyCode = SRC.IsoCurrencyCode
,CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId
,BranchId = SRC.BranchId
FROM BNKM.BusinessOnlineBankingAccount TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_BusinessOnlineBankingAccount_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.Id = TGT.Id AND DELTA.Version = TGT.Version AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_BusinessOnlineBankingAccount SRC ON SRC.Id = TGT.Id AND SRC.Version = TGT.Version ;
 

----INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.BusinessOnlineBankingAccount
( [Id]
 ,[Version]
 ,[RelatedCustomerAccountId]
 ,[TypeCdId]
 ,[Name]
 ,[OwnIndicator]
 ,[ReferenceNumber]
 ,[InternalRemarks]
 ,[ExternalRemarks]
 ,[IsoCurrencyCode]
 ,[CustomerAccountId]
 ,[BranchId]
 ,[FinancialInstitutionId]
 ,[SourceSystemCode]
 ,[WorkFlowId]
 ,[TaskRunId]
 ,[InsertDttm] )

SELECT
     Id
    ,Version
    ,RelatedCustomerAccountId
    ,TypeCdId
    ,Name
    ,OwnIndicator
    ,ReferenceNumber
    ,InternalRemarks
    ,ExternalRemarks
    ,IsoCurrencyCode
    ,CustomerAccountId
    ,BranchId
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,SourceCode AS SourceSystemCode
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_BusinessOnlineBankingAccount
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_BusinessOnlineBankingAccount;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_BusinessOnlineBankingAccount_DELTA;

END
